name: RfcUntouchedManualDraftHardDelete
purpose: Permit hard deletion only for the exceptionally narrow RFC state explicitly allowed by authority; otherwise preserve identity/history through lifecycle/archive/correction.

all_must_be_true: RFC was created manually/provisionally under local authority and has no accepted RFC/WFM source adoption/provenance
RFC has no active or historical RFC hierarchy edge as parent or child
RFC has no active or historical SR relationship
RFC has no active or historical Device Reference relationship
RFC has no Working Notes or removed/edited note audit history
RFC owns no WFM identity and no WFM/Task history
RFC participates in no Task/Objective/execution/review history
RFC has no Communication link/history whose retention depends on it
RFC has no accepted lifecycle/status/source evidence beyond its local creation
RFC has no prior archive/restore/correction history
audit provider classifies it as untouched-delete-eligible rather than history-bearing
all dependency providers return eligible; INDETERMINATE fails closed

preview.output: eligible boolean plus typed blockers from bounded dependency providers
preview.rule: preview is advisory and cannot authorize deletion

steps: rerun every eligibility guard against current state using indexed existence checks
if any blocker/indeterminate exists return RFC_HARD_DELETE_BLOCKED and make no mutation
delete only the RFC row and strictly local creation-only technical rows proven unprotected

insert required audit evidence for the deletion decision only if the accepted audit contract permits preserving evidence outside the deleted RFC; if audit would itself make the RFC non-untouched under policy, the command is disallowed rather than weakening the gate

rules: no cascade is used to manufacture eligibility
a manual RFC with any independently nondeletable WFM is not hard-deletable
ordinary imported/adopted/history-bearing RFCs use archive/terminal/correction flows instead
hard deletion never applies merely because RFC is archived, terminal, old, omitted from workbook, or currently has no active WFM
